A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border of the Light Side half (22 January 2023). The image is turned so that the Dark Side half reads upright, so the mark appears upside down at the top. Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:DS2-D-deathstariicapacitors-PC-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Star II: Capacitors (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same words as the E card. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size and turned 180° (Dark Side text upright), with the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”.

The whole E card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
